first_reader_said: 2CH 31:13: Both records hold the overseer under Conaniah in Hezekiah's reign; A identifies him with Heman's descendant Jehiel of the same reign.

why: Both records identify Jehiel as the overseer under Cononiah in Hezekiah’s reign in 2CH 31:13. B also preserves his descent from Heman in 2CH 29:14, which fits the same reform period; A supplies no distinguishing ancestry or role and is a thinner copy of B.
